title: Step 1 - Getting Started with Natural Language Processing: Sentiment Analysis

cues.en: -: Hello my friends, and welcome to this new part on natural language processing.
cues.zh: 講師：朋友們，大家好，歡迎來到自然語言處理這個新部分。

cues.en: I'm super excited to start this part because this is the branch of machine learning with which you can build chat bots and machine translations.
cues.zh: 很期待，因為這個機器學習分支能建立聊天機器人與機器翻譯。

cues.en: So, of course, this is not what we're gonna do in this part because this is really advanced NLP, so we'll just cover the basics with sentiment analysis which consists of training a machine
cues.zh: 當然這部分不做那些，因為屬於進階 NLP；先用情緒分析介紹基礎，也就是訓練機器

cues.en: to understand some text, and predict a certain outcome for these texts.
cues.zh: 理解文字，預測這些文字的某種結果。

cues.en: So in our case study here, these texts will be reviews of a restaurant and we'll have to train a machine to understand if each review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 案例文字是餐廳評論，訓練機器了解每則正面或負面。

cues.en: So very simple, very classic, but the best way to be introduced to NLP.
cues.zh: 簡單、經典，也是入門 NLP 最好的方式。

cues.en: All right, so before we start let's make sure everyone here is on the same page.
cues.zh: 開始前，確認大家進度一致。

cues.en: This is the folder containing all the codes and data-sets and of which I give you the link right before this tutorial in the article, so make sure to connect to that link.
cues.zh: 這是所有程式碼與資料集資料夾，前面文章有連結，請先開啟。

cues.en: And now there we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: We can enter part seven, natural language processing.
cues.zh: 進第七部分「自然語言處理」。

cues.en: So, in this part you will only find one section.
cues.zh: 只有一個單元。

cues.en: That's because we only do one case study of NLP about sentiment analysis.
cues.zh: 因為只做一個情緒分析案例。

cues.en: However, you will see that you can try diverse machine learning models to tackle the problem.
cues.zh: 但可以嘗試多種機器學習模型解問題。

cues.en: Indeed, the essential part of our implementation will be to build the bag of words model.
cues.zh: 實作核心是建立詞袋模型。

cues.en: But then once it is built, we can try several classification models.
cues.zh: 建好後，可以試多種分類模型。

cues.en: Why classification models?
cues.zh: 為什麼分類？

cues.en: That's because we'll have to predict, you know, a binary outcome, one or zero.
cues.zh: 因為預測二元結果，1 或 0。

cues.en: One meaning the review is positive, and zero meaning the review is negative.
cues.zh: 1 代表正評，0 代表負評。

cues.en: So you'll have actually the flexibility to try several machinery models, and this will actually be your final exercise of this section.
cues.zh: 所以能彈性嘗試不同模型，也是本單元最後練習。

cues.en: So there we go, let's do this.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's enter section 36 now, natural language processing.
cues.zh: 進第 36 節自然語言處理。

cues.en: And as usual, we're gonna start with Python in which you will find two files: the implementationnaturallanguageprocessing.ipynb, which you can open with either Google Colaboratory
cues.zh: 照慣例先 Python，有兩檔：natural_language_processing.ipynb，可用 Google Colaboratory

cues.en: or Jupyter Notebook.
cues.zh: 或 Jupyter Notebook 開啟。

cues.en: And our data-set, restaurantreviews.
cues.zh: 以及 Restaurant_Reviews 資料集。

cues.en: this time not csv, but tsv.
cues.zh: 這次不是 CSV，而是 TSV。

cues.en: And this will be a good opportunity for me to train you on how to import a TSV dataset.
cues.zh: 正好教你如何匯入 TSV。

cues.en: TSV means tab separate value instead of comma separate value like in a csv.
cues.zh: TSV 是定位字元分隔值，不是 CSV 的逗號分隔值。

cues.en: So basically the only difference is that in the previous data sets we worked with, well, you know the features and the dependent variable were separated by commas,
cues.zh: 基本唯一差別，先前特徵與應變數以逗號分隔，

cues.en: and in this one, well, instead of being separated by commas, the reviews and the dependent variable will be separated by a tab.
cues.zh: 這次評論與應變數用 Tab 分隔。

cues.en: And this makes sense, right?
cues.zh: 很合理，對吧？

cues.en: Because in the reviews we already have commas, and therefore that would create nonsense features.
cues.zh: 因為評論本身有逗號，否則會產生無意義的特徵。

cues.en: But let me show you what this data-set looks like.
cues.zh: 看看資料集樣子。

cues.en: So as you can see there are only two columns, the first one containing all the reviews.
cues.zh: 只有兩欄，第一欄包含所有評論。

cues.en: So for example, this is the first one: "Wow, love this place."
cues.zh: 例如第一則：「哇，好喜歡這裡。」

cues.en: A second one, "Crust is not good."
cues.zh: 第二則：「餅皮不好。」

cues.en: Another one, "Great touch." Et cetera.
cues.zh: 另一則：「很棒的細節。」等等。

cues.en: So you have in total, let's see, 1000 reviews, right?
cues.zh: 總共有一千則評論。

cues.en: So we're gonna train our machine learning to actually understand text and predict if the texts are positive or negative with 1000 texts.
cues.zh: 所以用一千段文字，訓練機器學習理解並預測正面或負面。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: And then the second column is of course if the review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 第二欄當然是評論正面或負面。

cues.en: So 1 means that it is positive meaning the customer liked it and 0 means that the review is negative.
cues.zh: 1 代表正面，顧客喜歡，0 代表負面。

cues.en: And of course, we have the real outcomes in order to train our missionary model to understand if each of these texts is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 當然有真實結果，才能訓練模型理解每段正或負。

cues.en: So that's purely, in the end, you know, a classification problem.
cues.zh: 所以最後純粹是分類問題。

cues.en: But the essential part of it is that we'll train the machine to understand these texts first, and then to predict if they are positive or negative.
cues.zh: 但關鍵是先訓練機器理解文字，再預測正面或負面。

cues.en: All right, so very simple case study, very simple data set.
cues.zh: 案例、資料集都很簡單。

cues.en: That means we are ready to start the implementation of natural language processing.
cues.zh: 準備開始 NLP 實作。

cues.en: So as you prefer, feel free to open it with either Google Colaboratory or Jupyter Notebook.
cues.zh: 可以隨喜好用 Google Colaboratory 或 Jupyter Notebook 開啟。

cues.en: I'm opening it with Google collab as usual, so feel free to do the same if you'd like.
cues.zh: 我照慣例用 Colab，想的話一起用。

cues.en: And now the notebook is loading in a second.
cues.zh: 筆記本正在載入。

cues.en: It'll be laying out.
cues.zh: 等一下配置版面。

cues.en: Alright, loading, laying out.
cues.zh: 載入、配置。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And this is the implementation.
cues.zh: 這就是實作。

cues.en: And as usual, this is in "read" on the mode and we want to re-implement this from scratch.
cues.zh: 照慣例是唯讀，要從零重新實作。

cues.en: Therefore we're gonna create a copy right away, so that we can modify the code inside.
cues.zh: 立刻建立副本，才能修改裡面程式碼。

cues.en: So we're gonna click "save a copy in drive" here, this will create a copy, after which we will be able to modify the code and re-implement this from scratch.
cues.zh: 點「在雲端硬碟中儲存副本」，建立後就能修改，從零重做。

cues.en: And speaking of re-implementing it from scratch, well let's delete all the code cells because we will re-implement them.
cues.zh: 說到從零，刪掉所有程式碼儲存格，因為都要重寫。

cues.en: So let's click this trash button here, in each of the code cells, but not the text so that we can keep the well highlighted structure and see where we are going
cues.zh: 各程式碼儲存格點垃圾桶，但保留文字，讓結構清楚，每個實作階段

cues.en: at each time of the implementation.
cues.zh: 都知道方向。

cues.en: All right, so almost done.
cues.zh: 快完成。

cues.en: It's actually an implementation in about 10 steps, but you will recognize some of the steps as steps we did before.
cues.zh: 大約十步，但某些步驟你會認得，之前做過。

cues.en: You'll see, I'm gonna show you in a second.
cues.zh: 等一下示範。

cues.en: All right, so let's have a look at the structure of this implementation.
cues.zh: 看看實作結構。

cues.en: We will start first by importing the libraries as usual because indeed we will need several libraries to pre-process our texts and train our future machine learning model.
cues.zh: 先照慣例匯入函式庫，因為前處理文字和訓練未來模型，都需要多個函式庫。

cues.en: Then we will import the data-set.
cues.zh: 再匯入資料集。

cues.en: So that's actually the data pre-processing phase.
cues.zh: 這是資料前處理階段。

cues.en: But not only that, the data pre-processing phase will also contain the next two cells, cleaning the text, indeed, we will have to simplify the text as much as we can
cues.zh: 不只如此，還包含下面兩個儲存格。清理文字，盡可能簡化，

cues.en: in order to ease the learning process of the machinery model.
cues.zh: 讓模型更容易學習。

cues.en: You know, we'll have to remove all the punctuations, we'll have to put all the letters in lower case, then we'll have to apply stemming, you know, we'll have to make very clean text to alleviate the learning process
cues.zh: 移除所有標點、字母轉小寫、做詞幹提取，建立乾淨文字，減輕

cues.en: of the future classification model we'll build, so that's a compulsory process when doing NLP, you have to pre-process the text basically.
cues.zh: 未來分類模型的學習負擔；NLP 必做，基本上要前處理文字。

cues.en: Then we'll create the back of words model, which is at the heart of sentiment analysis.
cues.zh: 接著建立詞袋模型，是情緒分析核心。

cues.en: And then, there you go, that's where you will recognize everything.
cues.zh: 之後你就都認得了。

cues.en: Once we have the back of words model we basically have a data-set ready to be trained, right?
cues.zh: 有詞袋，基本上資料集就準備好訓練。

cues.en: We have a data-set ready to be trained by a machine learning model, and that's why then we will just apply the classic process of training a model.
cues.zh: 準備交給機器學習模型，所以套用標準訓練流程。

cues.en: First, we will split the data-set into the training set and test set, so that we can indeed have a set where we train the model to understand text and predict if the texts
cues.zh: 先分訓練集與測試集，訓練模型理解文字，預測

cues.en: are positive or negative, and the test set, so that we can evaluate the performance on new texts on which the model wasn't trained.
cues.zh: 正面或負面；測試集則評估從沒訓練過的新文字表現。

cues.en: And then there we go, we train.
cues.zh: 再來訓練。

cues.en: So I chose a knife based model on the training set, but you will see that your final exercise at the end will be to try the other classification models, and see if you can beat the accuracy I will get
cues.zh: 我選 Naive Bayes，但最後練習會請你試其他分類模型，看看能否超過這次

cues.en: in this implementation, then we will predict the test set results, and finally we will make the confusion matrix and get the final accuracy.
cues.zh: 實作的準確率；接著預測測試集，最後建立混淆矩陣，取得最終準確率。

cues.en: So that's our structure, that's our NLP journey.
cues.zh: 這是架構，也是 NLP 旅程。

cues.en: So now as soon as you're ready, let's start in the next tutorial with the simple data pre-processing phase.
cues.zh: 準備好，下一堂先從簡單資料前處理開始。

cues.en: I can't wait to start.
cues.zh: 迫不及待。

cues.en: See you in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 下一堂見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
